scope: Terminal primary-study generation cells and all retained turn files only; no native results, SCC, analysis, task data, methods or final supplement.
compression: ZIP Deflate level 9; fixed entry date; non-seekable streams; ZIP64 JSONL entry; original bytes encoded as Base64 per path.
limits: Archives were streamed to a counter/hash sink, not saved or uploaded.
Original bytes can contain identifying local paths; no anonymity review or redaction was performed.
This sizing does not validate scientific endpoints or demonstrate a complete supplement under the limit.
A JSONL container requires an extraction tool and round-trip validation before use.

tar_comparison.container: One normalized PAX TAR, regular files only; file contents unchanged; TAR mode0644,mtime0,uid/gid0; fixed ZIP date; non-seekable ZIP streams and ZIP64 entry.
tar_comparison.lzma: Python zipfile ZIP_LZMA default encoder; no user-set compression preset.
limits: Archives were streamed to a counter/hash sink, not saved or uploaded.
Original bytes can contain identifying local paths; no anonymity review or redaction was performed.
This sizing does not validate scientific endpoints or demonstrate a complete supplement under the limit.
Nested TAR requires extraction; LZMA ZIP support is less universal than Deflate. No saved archive was extracted or round-trip tested.
